package rulefixtures

import "sync"

// scenario for race_on_shared_map: map reads/writes from multiple goroutines without mutex or `sync.Map` protection (detect goroutine launches + shared map access patterns)
// fixture polarity: positive; family: security; severity: warning.
var sharedCache = make(map[string]int)

func WriteToCache(items []string) map[string]int {
	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	for _, item := range items {
		wg.Add(1)
		go func(key string) {
			defer wg.Done()
			sharedCache[key]++
		}(item)
	}
	wg.Wait()
	return sharedCache
}

func ReadAndWriteCache(keys []string, values []int) {
	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	for i, k := range keys {
		wg.Add(1)
		go func(key string, val int) {
			defer wg.Done()
			_ = sharedCache[key]
			sharedCache[key] = val
		}(k, values[i])
	}
	wg.Wait()
}
